component-metadata.description:
Metanode for creation of FASTA file based on the two specified columns containing header and sequence.
Sequences strings are wrapped to have 60 letters on single sequence line.
The input table is processed by chunks (Chunk size parameter) and written into the single database file.
Please note, that if you leave the Overwrite checkbox unchecked and the database file will be existing already, the metanode will fail to execute, returning error that the file to be written to already exists.
